blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Ukraine-based firm linked to a banana chips company of Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, might be involved in money laundering, according to Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros. Hontiveros said her office conducted a review of some of foreign-based companies which remitted money to Cale88 Foods Corp., aside from those based in China. “It appears that at least one of them may be involved in money laundering activities,” the senator-judge said during the 37th day of the impeachment trial of the vice president. She then identified the company as Arkmen LCC, a Ukrainian remitter with an address in Zoriana 3A, Siboliv, […]...
